profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Developer with 3+ years of professional experience building and maintaining enterprise applications. Currently at Unwired Revolution, I develop and enhance RemoteLink, a platform focused on workflow automation, large-scale data movement, and enterprise orchestration.
 
My background includes full-stack development roles across .NET/C#, Java, Python, and modern JavaScript. I’ve worked on everything from complex enterprise platforms and research tools integrated with learning management systems to cloud-hosted APIs and production deployment processes.
 
Proficient in:
 
Full-Stack .NET (C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework/Core)
JavaScript (ES6+) & Frontend Development
Java Spring Boot & RESTful APIs
Python API Development
PostgreSQL & SQL Server
IIS, and Windows Installer (MSI)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-time role maintaining and enhancing RemoteLink, an enterprise platform delivering workflow automation, large-scale data movement, script orchestration, and state management for servers/clients.

Key contributions and technologies:
- Designed and implemented responsive, dynamic user interfaces using modern JavaScript libraries, significantly improving usability and user experience.
- Developed and maintained server-side logic with ASP.NET MVC, establishing robust client-server communication for real-time data collection, processing, and visualization.
- Built and deployed standalone .NET web applications that extend RemoteLink’s core functionality, providing customized tools and integrations for enterprise customers.
- Modernized and maintained the enterprise software installer (MSI/Windows Installer), ensuring reliable deployment and upgrades across complex, large-scale environments.
- Strengthened expertise in full-stack .NET development, enterprise design patterns, JavaScript ecosystem, and production-grade deployment processes.

Technologies: ASP.NET MVC, .NET Framework/Core, C#, JavaScript (ES6+), MSI/Windows Installer, IIS, SQL Server

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a cross-functional team of developers to design and build an experimental research platform seamlessly integrated with Canvas LMS.
- Developed backend services using Java Spring Boot, implemented RESTful APIs, and managed database schema migrations with Liquibase.
- Gained hands-on experience with modern frontend technologies including Vue.js and SCSS.
- Strengthened software engineering best practices through active participation in the full Git workflow (branching, code reviews, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines).
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · Software Development · GitHub · REST APIs · Agile Methodologies · Jira · Spring Boot · Web Development
